variables.name: FC Closed IN
variables.notes: 1 on every month that was already closed when the version was made. Inside its horizon the version shows the actuals of those months. Its plan starts from the last closed month. Empty elsewhere.

variables.name: FC Horizon IN
variables.notes: 1 on every month the version reports. Empty elsewhere.

variables.name: FC Actual
variables.notes: 1 where the version shows actuals: inside its horizon and already closed.

variables.name: FC Plan
variables.notes: 1 where the version shows plan: inside its horizon and not yet closed. Summed over a year, it counts the plan months.

variables.name: FC Plan Months
variables.notes: How many months of the year the version plans.

variables.name: IMPORT Volume
variables.notes: Units sold, net of returns.

variables.name: IMPORT Gross Sales
variables.notes: Invoiced amount at list price before any discount, net of returns.

variables.name: IMPORT Standard Discounts
variables.notes: Agreed trade discount, deducted on the invoice.

variables.name: IMPORT Promo Discounts
variables.notes: Temporary promotional price cut, deducted on the invoice.

variables.name: IMPORT Logistics Discounts
variables.notes: Discount for full pallets delivered to the customer's own warehouse, deducted on the invoice.

variables.name: IMPORT Promo Funding
variables.notes: Promotion payments per unit sold, settled with the customer after the promotion.

variables.name: IMPORT Rebates
variables.notes: Rebate accrual booked for the month, at the agreed rate. True-ups load in IMPORT Rebate True-ups. The agreement is with the group's head office, so the amount carries no customer and no SKU.

variables.name: IMPORT Rebate True-ups
variables.notes: One-off corrections of earlier rebate accruals, booked in the month they were made. They count in the P&L. They stay out of the rate the plan carries forward, so a one-off does not repeat in every plan month.

variables.name: IMPORT Growth Bonus
variables.notes: Growth bonus expense booked for the month. A group that is expected to beat its growth threshold accrues the bonus every month. True-ups follow when the expectation changes.

variables.name: IMPORT Trade Fees
variables.notes: Listing, shelf, leaflet and promotion fees, invoiced by the group's head office for one brand.

variables.name: IMPORT List Price
variables.notes: List price per unit in force in the month, in the country's currency.

variables.name: IMPORT Standard Cost
variables.notes: Standard production or purchase cost per unit in EUR, set once a year.

variables.name: IMPORT Unit Weight
variables.notes: Shipping weight of one unit in kg.

variables.name: IMPORT Handling Factor
variables.notes: Handling cost of one kg relative to ambient goods, from logistics costing. Chilled and frozen goods cost more to store and move.

variables.name: IMPORT FX Rate
variables.notes: Average rate of the month, units of local currency per EUR. Every rate must be above 0, and EUR itself is always 1.

variables.name: IMPORT OPEX
variables.notes: Operating expenses posted to cost centers, in the country's currency. Includes the marketing team's own costs. Excludes advertising and promotion spend, which loads in IMPORT Marketing, and deductions given to customers, which load above. Excludes factory overhead that the standard cost already covers. Loading any of these here too would count it twice.

variables.name: IMPORT Marketing
variables.notes: Advertising and promotion spend, booked per brand and country in the country's currency. Only spend on media, agencies, samples and displays. The marketing team's salaries are OPEX.

variables.name: IMPORT Control Total
variables.notes: Gross sales per country and month as stated by the export itself. Checks that the load lost nothing.

variables.name: Volume ACT
variables.notes: Actual units per planning SKU, summed over its materials. Unknown materials land on NULL (SKU).

variables.name: Invoice Sales ACT
variables.notes: Actual invoiced sales after the on-invoice discounts.
variables.formula: "Gross Sales ACT" - "Standard Discounts ACT" - "Promo Discounts ACT" - "Logistics Discounts ACT"

variables.name: Group Key ACT
variables.notes: Share of one customer and SKU in its group's invoice sales of the month. Empty when the group has no positive sales.
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales ACT by Group", 0), "Invoice Sales ACT" / "Invoice Sales ACT by Group")

variables.name: Rebate Expense ACT
variables.notes: The rebate expense of the month: the regular accrual plus any true-up.

variables.name: Rebates Unallocated ACT
variables.notes: Rebate expense of a month in which the group had no positive sales, so no customer can carry it. It still counts against the country's profit.

variables.name: Growth Bonus Unallocated ACT
variables.notes: Growth bonus expense of a month in which the group had no positive sales. It still counts against the country's profit.

variables.name: Gross Sales ACT by Group Brand
Standard Discounts ACT by Group Brand
Standard Discount Rate ACT
variables.notes: The standard discount the group actually got on the brand, as a share of gross sales. A brand the group bought without a discount has a rate of 0.
variables.formula: if(gt("Gross Sales ACT by Group Brand", 0), "Standard Discounts ACT by Group Brand" / "Gross Sales ACT by Group Brand")

variables.name: Rebate Rate ACT
variables.notes: The group's regular rebate accrual, as a share of its invoice sales. True-ups are left out, so a one-off correction does not become the plan's rate. A month with sales but no accrual has a rate of 0.
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales ACT by Group", 0), "IMPORT Rebates" / "Invoice Sales ACT by Group")

variables.name: Logistics Discount Rate ACT
variables.notes: The logistics discount the group actually got, as a share of gross sales. A month with sales but no logistics discount has a rate of 0.
variables.formula: if(gt("Gross Sales ACT by Group", 0), "Logistics Discounts ACT by Group" / "Gross Sales ACT by Group")

variables.name: COGS ACT
variables.notes: Actual cost of goods sold at standard cost, converted from EUR at the month's actual rate.

variables.name: Volume LY
variables.notes: Actual volume of the same month last year.

variables.name: Invoice Sales ACT LY
variables.notes: Actual invoice sales of the same month last year.

variables.name: Invoice Sales LY by Group
variables.notes: Last year's invoice sales of the group, for the growth bonus threshold.

variables.name: Volume Growth IN
variables.notes: Planned volume growth against the same month last year. A blank means no growth.

variables.name: Volume Target IN
variables.notes: Annual volume target in units for a chain or buying group and a category. Phased to customers, SKUs and months by last year's full-year mix. A version takes only the share of its plan months, so a forecast adds the rest of the target to its actuals. Where it exists it replaces the growth baseline.

variables.name: Volume Override IN
variables.notes: Volume typed by a key account manager. Replaces the baseline in that cell. Sparse.

variables.name: Price Increase IN
variables.notes: List price increase on top of the list price of the last closed month.

variables.name: Standard Discount IN
variables.notes: Agreed on-invoice discount rate, as a share of gross sales. Where it is empty, the last actual rate carries forward.

variables.name: Promo Discount IN
variables.notes: Promotional on-invoice discount, as a share of gross sales. Sparse promotion calendar.

variables.name: Logistics Discount IN
variables.notes: On-invoice discount for full pallets delivered to the group's own warehouse, as a share of gross sales. Where nobody typed a rate, the plan keeps the group's last actual rate.

variables.name: Rebate Rate IN
variables.notes: Off-invoice rebate, as a share of invoice sales. Where it is empty, the last actual rate carries forward.

variables.name: Growth Bonus Rate IN
variables.notes: Bonus as a share of invoice sales, for the whole year, if the group grows by more than its threshold. Type 0 for a group that will not earn it, which releases what the books accrued. A blank is no decision yet. The plan then keeps the accrual, and CHECK Growth Bonus shows it.

variables.name: Growth Bonus Threshold IN
variables.notes: Growth over last year's invoice sales that the group must beat to earn the bonus.

variables.name: Trade Fees IN
variables.notes: Planned listing, shelf, leaflet and promotion fees per group and brand. An amount, not a rate.

variables.name: Promo Funding IN
variables.notes: Planned promotion payments per customer, SKU and month. Sparse.

variables.name: Standard Cost IN
variables.notes: Planned standard cost per unit, in EUR. Where nobody typed one, the plan uses the SKU's actual standard cost of the year.

variables.name: FX Rate IN
variables.notes: Planning rate, units of local currency per EUR. Where nobody typed a rate, the plan keeps the last actual rate.

variables.name: Marketing Spend IN
variables.notes: Planned advertising and promotion spend per brand, in EUR.

variables.name: Marketing Split IN
variables.notes: Hand-entered allocation key: share of each brand's spend that goes to each country. Must add up to 1 per brand. CHECK Marketing Split shows the spend lost where it does not.

variables.name: OPEX IN
variables.notes: Planned operating expenses, entered by cost center managers.

variables.name: Volume LY Plan
variables.notes: Last year's volume, placed on each version's plan months.

variables.name: Volume Growth Baseline
variables.notes: Last year times planned growth. A blank growth means flat volume.

variables.name: Volume LY by Group Category
variables.notes: Last year's volume for the whole year, per group and category. The same in every version.

variables.name: Volume Target Key
variables.notes: Share of the annual target that falls on one customer, SKU and plan month: last year's volume there over the group and category's full year. Over twelve plan months the shares add up to 1.
variables.formula: if(gt("Volume LY by Group Category", 0), "Volume LY Plan" / "Volume LY by Group Category")

variables.name: Volume Target Cascade
variables.notes: The annual target, phased. Only plan months get a cell, so a forecast plans the rest of the year and keeps its actuals.

variables.name: Volume Baseline
variables.notes: The target cascade where a target exists, else the growth baseline.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Volume Target Cascade"), "Volume Target Cascade", "Volume Growth Baseline")

variables.name: Volume Planned
variables.notes: The override wins where a planner typed a value.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Volume Override IN"), "Volume Override IN", "Volume Baseline")

variables.name: Volume Plan
variables.notes: Planned volume on plan months only. Drops overrides typed into months the version does not plan.

variables.name: List Price Reset
variables.notes: Actual list price on the months that are closed for the version.

variables.name: List Price Carry
variables.notes: Holds the list price of the last closed month flat into later months.

variables.name: Standard Discount Rate Reset
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Closed IN", 1), "Standard Discount Rate ACT")

variables.name: Standard Discount Rate Carry
variables.notes: The last actual standard discount rate, held flat into later months.

variables.name: Standard Discount Rate
variables.notes: The rate the plan uses: typed where a planner typed one, else the last actual rate.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Standard Discount IN"), "Standard Discount IN", "Standard Discount Rate Carry")

variables.name: Rebate Rate Carry
variables.notes: The last actual rebate rate, held flat into later months.

variables.name: Rebate Rate
variables.notes: The rate the plan uses: typed where a planner typed one, else the last actual rate.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Rebate Rate IN"), "Rebate Rate IN", "Rebate Rate Carry")

variables.name: Logistics Discount Rate Reset
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Closed IN", 1), "Logistics Discount Rate ACT")

variables.name: Logistics Discount Rate Carry
variables.notes: The last actual logistics discount rate, held flat into later months.

variables.name: Logistics Discount Rate
variables.notes: The rate the plan uses: typed where a planner typed one, else the last actual rate.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Logistics Discount IN"), "Logistics Discount IN", "Logistics Discount Rate Carry")

variables.name: FX Rate Carry
variables.notes: The last actual exchange rate, held flat into later months.

variables.name: FX Rate Plan
variables.notes: The planning rate on plan months: typed where a planner typed one, else the last actual rate.
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Plan", 1), if(hasValue("FX Rate IN"), "FX Rate IN", "FX Rate Carry"))

variables.name: Gross Sales Plan
variables.notes: Planned units at the list price of the customer's country.

variables.name: Promo Discounts Plan
variables.notes: Only in promotion months. The rate is empty elsewhere, so the cell is too.

variables.name: Standard Cost Plan
variables.notes: The standard cost per unit the plan uses, in EUR: typed where a planner typed one, else the SKU's actual standard cost of the year. The actual cost has no versions, so the setting keeps it in every version.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Standard Cost IN"), "Standard Cost IN", "IMPORT Standard Cost")

variables.name: COGS Plan
variables.notes: Planned units at the planned standard cost, converted from EUR at the version's rate.

variables.name: Gross Sales
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Gross Sales ACT", "Gross Sales Plan")

variables.name: Standard Discounts
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Standard Discounts ACT", "Standard Discounts Plan")

variables.name: Promo Discounts
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Promo Discounts ACT", "Promo Discounts Plan")

variables.name: Logistics Discounts
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Logistics Discounts ACT", "Logistics Discounts Plan")

variables.name: Invoice Sales Plan
variables.notes: The base of the plan's rebates and growth bonus.

variables.name: Invoice Sales by Group Year
variables.notes: The group's invoice sales for the whole year in the version. A forecast adds its actual months to its plan months.

variables.name: Growth Bonus Rate
variables.notes: The typed bonus rate where the group beats last year by more than its threshold, else 0. Empty where no rate is typed. A change in any month's sales can switch it for the whole year.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Growth Bonus Rate IN"), if(gt("Invoice Sales LY by Group", 0), if(gt("Invoice Sales by Group Year", "Invoice Sales LY by Group" * (1 + "Growth Bonus Threshold IN")), "Growth Bonus Rate IN", 0), 0))

variables.name: Growth Bonus Entitlement
variables.notes: The bonus the group earns on the whole year's invoice sales, closed months and plan months together. Zero when it misses its threshold, also when it has no sales this year at all. Empty when no rate is typed.
variables.formula: if(hasValue("Growth Bonus Rate"), if(gt("Growth Bonus Rate", 0), "Invoice Sales by Group Year" * "Growth Bonus Rate", 0))

variables.name: Growth Bonus Booked Monthly
variables.notes: Growth bonus the books already charged, in the months the version shows actuals.

variables.name: Invoice Sales Plan by Group Year
Growth Bonus Remaining
variables.notes: What the plan months still have to carry. It is the year's entitlement less what the closed months booked. Negative when the group booked more than it now earns. Empty when no rate is typed, or when the version plans no month of the year.
variables.formula: if(gt("FC Plan Months", 0), if(hasValue("Growth Bonus Entitlement"), "Growth Bonus Entitlement" - "Growth Bonus Booked"))

variables.name: Growth Bonus Plan
variables.notes: The remaining bonus, spread over the plan months by planned invoice sales.
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales Plan by Group Year", 0), "Growth Bonus Remaining" * ("Invoice Sales Plan" / "Invoice Sales Plan by Group Year"))

variables.name: Growth Bonus Plan Unallocated
variables.notes: The remaining bonus of a group with no planned sales left, spread evenly over the plan months. No customer can carry it, so it stays at group level. A plan month means the year has at least one, so the division is safe. The remainder multiplies the share, so a group without one gets no cell.
variables.formula: if(and(eq("FC Plan", 1), not(gt("Invoice Sales Plan by Group Year", 0))), "Growth Bonus Remaining" * (1 / "FC Plan Months"))

variables.name: Marketing Split Monthly
variables.notes: The annual key repeated on every month, so one operand of the split carries the whole grain.

variables.name: Marketing Plan EUR
variables.notes: Brand spend split to countries by the hand-entered key, still in EUR.

variables.name: Marketing Plan
variables.notes: The country's share of the brand spend, in the country's currency.

variables.name: Volume
variables.notes: Units sold. Actual or plan, depending on the version and month.

variables.name: Promo Funding
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Promo Funding ACT", "Promo Funding Plan")

variables.name: Growth Bonus
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Growth Bonus ACT", "Growth Bonus Plan")

variables.name: Rebates Unallocated
variables.notes: Actual rebate expense that no customer could carry, on the months the version shows actuals.

variables.name: Growth Bonus Unallocated
variables.notes: Growth bonus that no customer could carry. Actual expense on the months the version shows actuals, and the plan's rest for a group with no planned sales left.
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "Growth Bonus Unallocated ACT", "Growth Bonus Plan Unallocated")

variables.name: Trade Fees Pool
variables.notes: Trade fees to spread to the group's customers for the brand.
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "IMPORT Trade Fees", "Trade Fees Plan")

variables.name: Marketing Pool
variables.notes: Marketing spend to allocate to the country's customers, in the country's currency.

variables.name: FX Rate
variables.notes: Units of local currency per EUR: the actual rate on actual months, the version's planning rate on plan months.
variables.formula: if(eq("FC Actual", 1), "IMPORT FX Rate", "FX Rate Plan")

variables.name: Volume KG
variables.notes: Net kg, after returns.

variables.name: Handling KG
variables.notes: Net kg weighted by temperature zone. A frozen kg counts as more than an ambient one.

variables.name: Invoice Sales Positive
variables.notes: Invoice sales where they are positive, per SKU line. The trade fee key uses it. A line whose returns beat its sales gets no share of a fee, while the customer's other SKUs still do.

variables.name: Trade Fees Key
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales by Group Brand", 0), "Invoice Sales Positive" / "Invoice Sales by Group Brand")

variables.name: Trade Fees Unallocated
variables.notes: Fees for a brand the group had no positive sales of that month, for example a listing fee before the first delivery.

variables.name: Net Sales
variables.notes: Deductions that no customer could carry are not in it. The P&L holds them on their own lines.

variables.name: Gross Margin
variables.notes: Net sales less the cost of goods sold, at standard cost. A management margin after allocated trade deductions, readable by any customer, SKU or category. Deductions that no customer could carry are not in it.

variables.name: Logistics Pool
variables.notes: Warehouse and transport cost centers of the country.

variables.name: Handling KG Positive
variables.notes: Handling kg where they are positive. Net kg are only a stand-in for shipped kg. A customer whose returns beat its deliveries gets no logistics cost instead of a credit.
variables.formula: if(gt("Handling KG by Customer Brand", 0), "Handling KG by Customer Brand")

variables.name: Logistics Key
variables.formula: if(gt("Handling KG by Country", 0), "Handling KG Positive" / "Handling KG by Country")

variables.name: Logistics Unallocated
variables.notes: Logistics cost of a country and month with nothing shipped.

variables.name: Sales Force Pool
variables.notes: Sales team cost centers. Each serves one channel in one country.

variables.name: Invoice Sales Positive by Customer Brand
variables.notes: A customer's invoice sales of a brand where they are positive. The sales force key uses it.
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales by Customer Brand", 0), "Invoice Sales by Customer Brand")

variables.name: Sales Force Key
variables.formula: if(gt("Invoice Sales by Channel Country", 0), "Invoice Sales Positive by Customer Brand" / "Invoice Sales by Channel Country")

variables.name: Sales Force Unallocated
variables.notes: Cost of a sales team whose channel had no positive sales that month.

variables.name: Contribution Margin II
variables.notes: Gross margin less the cost to serve the customer, logistics and the sales force. Both are allocated fixed pools, so dropping a customer would not save its share.
variables.formula: "Gross Margin by Customer Brand" - "Logistics Cost" - "Sales Force Cost"

variables.name: Net Sales Positive
variables.notes: A customer's net sales of a brand where they are positive. The marketing key uses it.
variables.formula: if(gt("Net Sales by Customer Brand", 0), "Net Sales by Customer Brand")

variables.name: Marketing Key
variables.formula: if(gt("Net Sales by Brand Country", 0), "Net Sales Positive" / "Net Sales by Brand Country")

variables.name: Marketing Unallocated
variables.notes: Brand spend in a country and month with no positive net sales of the brand, for example a campaign before a launch.

variables.name: Contribution Margin III
variables.notes: Contribution margin II less the brand's marketing, in the country's currency. Costs that no customer could carry are not in it. Layer 7 takes them off the country's profit.

variables.name: Overheads
variables.notes: Every operating expense that is not allocated to customers. That includes cost centers missing from master data, which load under NULL (Function) and NULL (Country).

variables.name: Contribution Margin III by Country
variables.notes: Brings contribution margin III to the country grain, so the EBIT sum has operands at the same grain.

variables.name: Unallocated by Country
variables.notes: Deductions and costs that no customer could carry. Customer profitability leaves them out, but the country's profit must not.
variables.formula: "Rebates Unallocated by Country" + "Growth Bonus Unallocated by Country" + "Trade Fees Unallocated by Country" + "Logistics Unallocated" + "Sales Force Unallocated" + "Marketing Unallocated"

variables.name: EBIT OUT
variables.notes: Operating profit, in the country's currency.
variables.formula: "Contribution Margin III by Country" - "Overheads" - "Unallocated by Country"

variables.name: EBIT EUR OUT
variables.notes: Operating profit in EUR, at the actual rate on actual months and at the version's planning rate on plan months. Countries without a rate stay empty.

variables.name: PL OUT
variables.notes: Management P&L by brand, channel and country, in the country's currency. Summed over all lines it is EBIT.
variables.formula: "PL Gross Sales" + "PL Standard Discounts" + "PL Promo Discounts" + "PL Logistics Discounts" + "PL Rebates" + "PL Growth Bonus" + "PL Trade Fees" + "PL Promo Funding" + "PL COGS" + "PL Logistics" + "PL Sales Force" + "PL Marketing" + "PL Overheads" + "PL Rebates Unallocated" + "PL Growth Bonus Unallocated" + "PL Trade Fees Unallocated" + "PL Logistics Unallocated" + "PL Sales Force Unallocated" + "PL Marketing Unallocated"

variables.name: PL EUR OUT
variables.notes: The P&L in EUR, at the actual rate on actual months and at the version's planning rate on plan months. Countries can be added up here.

variables.name: Volume for KPIs
variables.notes: Units at the grain of the P&L, only where the country has a rate for the month. So the net price per unit divides EUR sales by the units of the same countries.
variables.formula: if(gt("FX Rate", 0), "Volume by Brand Channel Country")

variables.name: Net Price per Unit
variables.notes: Net sales in EUR per unit sold.
variables.formula: sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145)) / "Volume for KPIs"

variables.name: Gross-to-Net %
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145)) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Gross Margin %
variables.notes: Gross margin over net sales. Gross margin is a management margin at standard cost, after allocated trade deductions.
variables.formula: sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145, "PL Line">P150)) / sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145))

variables.name: Contribution Margin II %
variables.notes: Contribution margin II over net sales. It is gross margin after the cost to serve, logistics and the sales force.
variables.formula: sum("PL EUR OUT", not(or("PL Line">P190, "PL Line">P210))) / sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145))

variables.name: Contribution Margin III %
variables.notes: Contribution margin III over net sales. It is contribution margin II after marketing.
variables.formula: sum("PL EUR OUT", not(or("PL Line">P210))) / sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145))

variables.name: EBIT %
variables.notes: EBIT over net sales. Overheads and costs that no customer could carry sit on NULL (Brand), so one brand or channel shows its margin after allocated costs only.
variables.formula: "PL EUR OUT" / sum("PL EUR OUT", or("PL Line">P100, "PL Line">P110, "PL Line">P120, "PL Line">P125, "PL Line">P130, "PL Line">P135, "PL Line">P140, "PL Line">P145))

variables.name: Standard Discounts % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P110) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Promo Discounts % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P120) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Logistics Discounts % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P125) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Rebates % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P130) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Growth Bonus % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P135) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Trade Fees % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P140) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Promo Funding % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P145) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: COGS % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P150) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Logistics % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P170) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Sales Force % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P180) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Marketing % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P190) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Overheads % of Gross Sales
variables.formula: -1 * sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P210) / sum("PL EUR OUT", "PL Line">P100)

variables.name: Gross Sales Loaded by Country
variables.notes: What the load put into each country. It has its own cells, so the check below shows a country that has sales but no control total.

variables.name: CHECK Import Total
variables.notes: Control total of the export minus what was loaded, per country. Zero after a correct load. Sales without a control total show with a minus sign. So do customers missing from master data, under NULL (Country).
variables.formula: "IMPORT Control Total" - "Gross Sales Loaded by Country"

variables.name: CHECK Marketing Split
variables.notes: Planned marketing spend, in EUR, that the typed country split loses. Zero when every brand's split adds up to 1.

variables.name: CHECK Growth Bonus
variables.notes: The year's bonus entitlement minus what the year books and plans, in every version that plans part of the year. Zero when the plan months carry the rest. A group with booked bonus but no typed rate shows its booked amount with a minus sign, because a blank rate is no decision.
variables.formula: if(gt("FC Plan Months", 0), "Growth Bonus Entitlement" - "Growth Bonus Booked" - "Growth Bonus Plan" - "Growth Bonus Plan Unallocated")

variables.name: CHECK OPEX in EBIT
variables.notes: Operating expenses that never reach EBIT. Zero when healthy.
variables.formula: "OPEX by Country" - "Overheads" - "Logistics Cost" - "Logistics Unallocated" - "Sales Force Cost" - "Sales Force Unallocated"

variables.name: CHECK Uncosted Volume
variables.notes: Actual units of SKUs without a standard cost, usually material codes missing from master data. Their COGS is missing, so gross margin is too high.

variables.name: CHECK Uncosted Plan Volume
variables.notes: Planned units of SKUs with no standard cost at all, typed or actual. Their COGS is missing, so planned gross margin is too high.

variables.name: CHECK Unpriced Volume
variables.notes: Planned units of SKUs without a list price in the customer's country. Their sales would silently go missing.

variables.name: CHECK Volume without FX Rate
variables.notes: Units in a version and month without a valid rate for the customer's currency. A missing, zero or negative rate all count. Their COGS and their EUR figures go missing. Customers missing from master data have no currency and show here too.

variables.name: CHECK Marketing without FX Rate
variables.notes: Planned marketing in EUR that cannot convert, because the country has no valid planning rate for the month. It is missing from the country's costs.

variables.name: CHECK PL without FX Rate
variables.notes: Size of every P&L line that the EUR P&L leaves out, because the country has no valid rate for the month. Shown as a positive amount, so lines cannot cancel each other out. Customers and cost centers missing from master data have no country, so they show here under NULL (Country).

variables.name: CHECK EUR Rate
variables.notes: The EUR rate minus 1. Zero when healthy. Every EUR amount assumes its rate is exactly 1.
